invariants.description: Planning approval is not authorization to implement or deploy.
Secrets never enter source history, client output, model-visible CRM data or continuity state.
CRM facts and action outcomes come from the system of record; model interpretation is not a replacement.
Only approved schema/components render within a stable shell.
Consequential mutations require validated human approval on the server.
Missing/stale checks are incomplete; current evidence and gates, not narrative DONE, determine completion.

checks.description: Sources, requirement/check IDs and explicit exclusions are durably mapped.
State and instructions block scaffold, dependency installation, API calls, deployment and application implementation until explicit user authorization.
Manifest/source hashes, version, event ledger and per-check states reconcile; no product check is marked passed without current evidence.
A fresh session can reconcile Git and state, find unresolved decisions and stop at the authorization hold without relying on chat.

requirements.title: Single application stack and server boundary

checks.description: Compatible package/model selections are verified and recorded at implementation time; no unsupported version claims.
The approved stack remains a single application with one design system and no unneeded services.
Model key is server-only, not committed/logged/bundled or sent to the browser; model ID is configurable.
Seeded customers, deals, activities and tasks persist across reloads and have consistent references.
Summary totals and selected source fields match database queries.
No persistent Situation/Recommendation lifecycle or excluded infrastructure is introduced.
Customers, deals, activities and tasks are inspectable with scope/counts and a simple pipeline/table view.
Workspace evidence links open the correct underlying source record.
Explore remains usable when the LLM is unavailable; supported manual operations and limits are explicit.

requirements.title: Real model and bounded agent loop

checks.description: A real configured DeepSeek model selects and executes real tools over seed data; it is not keyword routing or canned responses.
At least one follow-up question uses retrieved context to produce source-backed interpretation, not only a workspace label.
The run has explicit tool/step/time bounds and handles model or provider failure without fabricated success.
The five agreed read tools return deterministic source data with validated inputs and results.
get_account_context aggregates related data without hidden model calls; invalid IDs, missing records and permission failures are explicit.
Local tools are sufficient for the core demo; MCP and direct arbitrary database access are not required or exposed.
Focus selects relevant situations and exposes evidence from actual tool results.
Investigation shows source-backed timeline, evidence and recommendation.
Comparison presents actual values for the requested small record set.
Zod rejects invalid/unknown workspace output; direct mappings use only approved primitives and never execute generated JSX/HTML.
Today renders deterministic CRM totals independently of model interpretation, with accurate activity status.
Situation scope, relevant time range and freshness are tied to actual retrieved data; partial coverage is not described as all records.
Facts are distinct from hypotheses; evidence is inspectable and unsupported numerical confidence is absent.
Today/Workspace/Explore navigation remains stable, with situation-first work and progressive evidence/source access.
One clear primary action and one shared design system apply across agent and Explore views.
Loading, empty and failure states are truthful and recoverable; completed/unavailable actions reflect server results.
Long content and narrow/mobile views remain operable without losing actions or source access.
Keyboard, focus, semantics/labels, contrast, target sizes and non-color meaning are checked; automation alone is not a WCAG compliance claim.
DEC-001 is resolved to exactly one mutation and demo/checks are reconciled; no real outbound email is included.
Proposed target, parameters and relevant impact/evidence are visible before explicit approval; rejecting causes no mutation.
Server enforces permission and validates the actual approved action; a model assertion or altered payload cannot authorize a write.
Failure is not shown as success; repeated approval/retry cannot silently duplicate the action, and success is visible in Explore.
The reference focus -> investigate -> approve -> inspect loop runs end to end with seed data and a real model.
Changed seed data and paraphrased requests change relevant results appropriately; automated fixtures are distinguished from live-model evidence.
Vitest/Playwright coverage and relevant UX/failure evidence are linked to exact checks and the verified commit/artifact.
Current scope capture/completion gates pass and a fresh reviewer pass records and disposes material findings before final implementation close/merge.
